requirement: Make the app better and faster
problem_statement: The request "Make the app better and faster" is underspecified. Convert it into measurable acceptance criteria before committing to a design.

ambiguities.question: Better by which measurable criterion (speed, correctness, UX, cost)?
ambiguities.assumption: No change is made until a measurable acceptance criterion is agreed.

ambiguities.question: What outcome, for which users, would make this successful?
ambiguities.assumption: No implementation begins until success criteria are agreed.

ambiguities.question: Which operation must be faster, by how much, and how is it measured?
ambiguities.assumption: Latency of the hot path is the target; baseline first, then require a measurable improvement.

assumptions: better: No change is made until a measurable acceptance criterion is agreed.
scope: No implementation begins until success criteria are agreed.
faster: Latency of the hot path is the target; baseline first, then require a measurable improvement.

tasks.title: Resolve ambiguities with stakeholders (blocking)

ai_assist.prompt: Requirement: "Make the app better and faster". Generate the most valuable clarifying questions ranked by impact, with a safe default assumption for each.
ai_assist.ai_role: Drafts ranked questions and default assumptions.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Asks stakeholders; no implementation starts on unanswered high-impact questions.

validation: All high-impact ambiguities answered or explicitly assumed

tasks.title: Time-boxed spike on a thin vertical slice

ai_assist.prompt: Sketch the thinnest end-to-end slice that would validate the riskiest assumption in "Make the app better and faster".
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Decides what the spike proves and discards the code if it is not production quality.

tasks.title: Define API contract and data schema

ai_assist.prompt: Draft an OpenAPI 3 contract and relational schema for: "Make the app better and faster". Include error responses, pagination and validation limits.
ai_assist.ai_role: Produces a first-draft contract and schema.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Reviews naming, status codes, backwards compatibility and constraints.

validation: Every endpoint has success and error cases

tasks.title: Implement core domain logic

ai_assist.prompt: Implement the domain service for "Make the app better and faster" behind a repository interface. Keep I/O out of the domain layer and return typed errors.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Reviews design boundaries, error handling and complexity line by line.

validation: No business logic in transport layer

ai_assist.prompt: Expose the service for "Make the app better and faster" through the OpenAPI contract with strict input validation and consistent errors.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Verifies behaviour matches the contract exactly.

tasks.title: Security and performance hardening

ai_assist.prompt: Review this implementation of "Make the app better and faster" for injection, abuse, resource exhaustion and N+1 queries. List findings with severity.
ai_assist.ai_role: Acts as a second reviewer producing a findings list.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Triages every finding; fixes or documents each one.

validation: Each finding resolved or accepted with rationale

tasks.title: Write unit and integration tests

ai_assist.prompt: Write pytest unit and integration tests for "Make the app better and faster" covering happy path, boundaries, errors and concurrency. Prefer behaviour over implementation.
ai_assist.ai_role: Generates test cases and fixtures, including edge cases the engineer may miss.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Checks each test can fail (mutation by hand), removes tautologies, sets the coverage bar.

validation: Tests fail when behaviour is deliberately broken

tasks.title: Write documentation

ai_assist.prompt: Draft README setup steps and architecture notes for "Make the app better and faster" from the code and contract. Flag anything you cannot verify.
ai_assist.ai_role: Drafts prose from code and contract.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Executes every documented command and corrects inaccuracies.

validation: A new engineer can run the project using only the README

ai_assist.prompt: Act as a skeptical reviewer of this change for "Make the app better and faster". List correctness, security, maintainability and test gaps.
ai_assist.ai_role: Independent review pass to catch blind spots.
ai_assist.engineer_owns: Owns the merge decision and the known-limitations list.

risks.risk: Building the wrong thing because key questions were never answered.
risks.mitigation: Blocking clarification task; spike validates the riskiest assumption before commitment.
Keep spike code disposable; plan is regenerated once ambiguities are resolved.

risks.risk: AI output looks plausible but is incorrect or uses non-existent APIs.
risks.mitigation: Every generated unit is run, type-checked and covered by tests before acceptance.

risks.risk: AI-written tests may be tautological and miss gaps (coverage illusion).
risks.mitigation: Engineer breaks the code deliberately to confirm tests fail; coverage is a floor, not proof.

risks.risk: Inefficient or insecure patterns (N+1 queries, string-built SQL, weak randomness).
risks.mitigation: Checklist review for SQL, randomness, input validation and complexity; separate AI review pass.

risks.risk: Sensitive data or proprietary code exposed to AI tools.
risks.mitigation: Prompts contain requirements and snippets only; no secrets or customer data.

trade_offs.rationale: Reproducible and reviewable; less flexible. LLM output would still need engineer review.

trade_offs.chosen: Contract and tests before wide implementation
trade_offs.rationale: Slower start, fewer rework cycles and clearer acceptance criteria.

limitations: Plans are templates tailored by keyword detection, not deep semantic understanding.
AI prompts are generated for an engineer to run in Copilot/ChatGPT; the tool calls no model itself.
